title: Crochet Layered Flower Hair Clip
name: Layered Flower Clip
seoTitle: Crochet Layered Flower Hair Clip Pattern (Free PDF)
description: Free crochet layered flower hair clip pattern: a front layer of tr petals in front loops and a bigger back layer in back loops. Printable PDF, step by step.
lead: A two-layer flower for a hair clip. The small front petals use the front loops and the bigger back petals use the back loops of the same round, so the layers sit neatly on top of each other.
yarn: Cotton yarn in one or two colours

materialsTable.details: Cotton yarn, one or two colours
Hair clip and glue or thread

notes: dtr (double treble): yarn over 3 times, then pull through 2 loops 4 times.

rounds.text: 5 sc in a magic ring, sl st, ch 1.

sections.title: Part 2: Front petals
sections.note: Work in the front loops of round 2.

rounds.text: (ch 4, 2 tr in this st, 2 tr in next st, ch 4, sl st in the same st) x5. sl st.
On each petal: (ch 3, sl st) x3 in the next st, ch 5, sl st in the centre. Repeat on all 5 petals.

sections.title: Part 3: Back petals
sections.note: sl st in the first back loop of round 2 and work in back loops.

rounds.text: (ch 4, 2 tr in this st, dtr in next st, 2 tr in next st, ch 4, sl st in the same st) x5. Fasten off.

finishing: Glue or sew the flower onto a hair clip.
